design.text: Good morning! Here's your day at a glance. You have three meetings, and the first one is at nine thirty with the team. The forecast says sixty-four degrees, with a bit of rain late this afternoon, so grab an umbrella. You slept seven hours last night, a little better than yesterday. Want me to remind you fifteen minutes before the meeting? I'm right here if you need anything.
design.note: 2026-10-15: one Qwen take per candidate written natively in the language (native-speaker accent), three seeds per Bip, picked by ear among 15

galet.design_instruct: Voice of a small, composed mascot, medium-low pitch, clear and confident, steady pace, the tone of a calm guide who explains things clearly, slightly stylized timbre like an animated character, never robotic, clean studio recording with no echo. Native speaker, standard American English accent.
